introH2: 🏥 What kinds of stays are near Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital sits on Srinagarindra Road in Suan Luang, east Bangkok — a quiet residential district, not a hotel corridor, which makes choosing the right place to stay more important here than almost anywhere else. For patients and families who need to get to and from the hospital repeatedly across several days, proximity is everything: no waiting for a Grab, no fighting traffic, no hauling luggage in and out of a car every morning. This article rounds up 6 stays near Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital that we've already reviewed in depth — one you can walk to the hospital entrance in 5 minutes, a 4-star hotel where the hospital sends a free minibus to collect you, a resort with the closest outdoor pool to the hospital in the area, a budget indoor-pool apartment, a hotel with a full spa and onsen, and a full-kitchen serviced apartment for genuine long stays. Every pick is based on reading real guest reviews — with the genuine upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: There is no skytrain station directly in front of Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital. The closest transit is Airport Rail Link (ARL) Hua Mak station, which sits roughly 1.5 to 3.5 km from the stays in this article depending on which you choose. From Hua Mak you can ride ARL direct to Suvarnabhumi Airport in about 20 minutes, or ride into Phaya Thai and connect to the BTS. MRT Yellow Line runs along Srinagarindra Road through the area — the nearest station is Sri Kritha, though you'll still need a motorbike taxi or Grab from there to the hospital. Seacon Square and The Nine Center (both with food courts, restaurants, and supermarkets) are a short drive from every stay listed here. For anyone driving in from upcountry, free parking is a major practical factor — every stay in this roundup offers it.

entries.name: The 9 Residence Hotel
entries.badge: 🏥 5-min walk to hospital · Closest stay in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Itsara Chai Alley · 150 m / 5-min walk to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital · ARL Hua Mak ~1.7 km
entries.addr: 9 Itsara Chai Alley (Soi Rama 9/59), Pattanakarn Road, Suan Luang, Bangkok
entries.storyHtml: The 9 Residence Hotel is the most direct answer to the question of which stay is closest to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital — just 150 metres from the hospital entrance, a 5-minute walk through Itsara Chai Alley with no main road to cross and no Grab to wait for. What reviews consistently praise is that every single room comes with a private balcony, which is rare at this price, along with rooms that are cleaner and more spacious than you'd expect — cleanliness scores 8.8/10 on Trip.com — plus free parking and a 24-hour front desk. The honest caveats: thin walls in some rooms let through noise from next door, some staff have limited English, and there is no pool, gym, or complimentary breakfast — if none of those are deal-breakers for you, being 150 metres from the hospital is something no other stay in this list can match.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Tell the front desk at check-in if you need a quiet room — they can place you away from shared walls. Order breakfast the evening before if you have an early hospital appointment. The Deluxe Suite at 52 sqm is practical when two caregivers are sharing.

entries.name: Onix Hotel Bangkok
entries.badge: 🚐 Hospital sends a free shuttle to your door · Most reviewed
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rama IX Soi 53 · ~500 m / 4-min drive to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital · Free hospital minibus to hotel
entries.storyHtml: Onix Hotel Bangkok is the 4-star option in the area — 73 rooms decorated with marble and onyx, cleanliness scoring 9.2 on Trip.com, and a genuine differentiator that no other stay in this list has: Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital sends a free minibus to collect guests directly from the hotel door. Multiple reviews confirm this service is real — you just let the front desk know in advance and coordinate the timing. For a patient or caregiver who finds moving around difficult, cutting out taxis and wait times entirely is substantial. Rooms run 28 to 38 sqm from ฿900, and the 24-hour Daddy G's bar and restaurant means you can eat when you get back from a late hospital visit. Honest caveats: there is no pool, breakfast is priced separately at ฿350 per person, and the soi location means you'll need a Grab for anything other than the hospital — but if the hospital is the main purpose, this is the best-quality room in the area at this price point.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask the front desk to arrange the hospital minibus in advance — no need to call a taxi yourself. If you're driving up from another province, free in-hotel parking is available.

entries.addr: 43/2 Soi Rama 9 Soi 57/1, Suan Luang, Bangkok
entries.storyHtml: The Pool Resort Bangkok is a small 22-room resort that holds one claim no other stay with a pool in this area can beat: it sits just 0.3 km from Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital, a 3-minute drive — on a calm day you could walk. Its main draw is a garden-surrounded outdoor pool with a jacuzzi that reviews consistently describe as cool, clean, and well-suited to unwinding after a long hospital day — a genuine luxury at this price point, from ฿650. The honest picture from the reviews is mixed on room condition: some guests reported aging ceilings, a shower that let water spill out, and inconsistent maintenance. The review count is also thin at only 20. That said, for a family needing a budget stay with a pool within walking distance of the hospital, the competition in this area is thin.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Always check recent room photos on the booking platform before confirming — room quality varies. Getting to ARL Hua Mak requires a Grab (~10 min). The on-site restaurant serves meals and offers 24-hour room service.

entries.name: Sky Place Srinakarin
entries.badge: 🏊 Indoor pool + sauna · Best budget pick with a pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Srinagarindra Road · ~0.5 km / 4-min drive to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital · ARL Hua Mak ~720 m / ~9-min walk
entries.storyHtml: Sky Place Srinakarin is the budget pick among the pool options — an ~80-room serviced apartment on Srinagarindra Road, 0.5 km from the hospital, and the lowest-priced stay in this article that includes a swimming pool: an indoor pool with sauna and a gym, all from ฿600 per night. Reviews note rooms that are roomier than the price suggests, housekeeping daily, free parking, and a free shuttle service within 500 m — useful when you're carrying medical bags. ARL Hua Mak is about 720 m on foot, making airport connections easy. The trade-offs are straightforward from the reviews: an aging building with dated interiors in many rooms, staff with limited English, and a breakfast offering that amounts to bread and jam. If your priority is a pool close to the hospital at a price that leaves room in the budget for hospital bills, this place delivers what others cannot at this price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check recent room photos on the platform before booking — some rooms have been renovated, others haven't. For communication, Google Translate works fine. ARL Hua Mak is 720 m away; the hotel's free 500 m shuttle can help get you to the station mouth.

entries.name: The Xtreme Suites
entries.badge: 🧖 Best amenity package — pool + spa + onsen + rock wall
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Huamark Road · ~1.5 km / 5-min drive to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital · ARL Hua Mak ~700 m / ~9-min walk
entries.storyHtml: The Xtreme Suites is a 90-room 3-star hotel on Huamark Road with an amenity package you rarely find at this price range: an outdoor pool, onsen, spa, a rock-climbing wall, a fitness room, and an on-site restaurant, all under one roof from ฿900 a night. It sits about 1.5 km from Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital — a 5-minute Grab ride — making it the right pick for families who need to be near the hospital for several days and want somewhere to unwind between visits rather than just a place to sleep. Across 561 Booking.com reviews, guests frequently praise the rooms for being more spacious and comfortable than the price implies, and single out the onsen as a genuine highlight. Honest caveats: the pool is smaller in person than in the promotional photos and better for soaking than lap swimming, some rooms show wear and maintenance issues, and there is no free hospital transfer. ARL Hua Mak at 700 m is a real practical plus for airport trips.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a renovated room at check-in — room quality varies between floors. Book spa or onsen time in advance with the front desk, especially after a long hospital day. ARL Hua Mak is 700 m; a motorbike taxi from the hotel takes a couple of minutes.

entries.storyHtml: Floraville Serviced Apartments is a 200-unit complex in Soi Pattanakarn 51 — about a 6-minute drive from Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital. The core appeal is practical: many units have a full kitchen with a hob, refrigerator, microwave, and washing machine, letting you cook your own meals and do laundry in the room, which matters a lot over a multi-week hospital stay. ARL Hua Mak is roughly 600 m away. The honest picture from the reviews, however, is that this ranks last in the list for a reason — the pool is drained and closed, the gym has broken equipment and no air conditioning, the building is worn down, most units are vacant which creates an unsettling atmosphere, and room condition varies sharply from unit to unit. Reviews on TripAdvisor average only 2.4/5. This is a niche pick: suitable only if a full kitchen is non-negotiable for a long stay and you're prepared to request photos of the specific unit and confirm its condition in detail before committing.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Before confirming, ask specifically which units are recently maintained and request real photos — do not assume the pool or gym is usable. Ask about weekly or monthly rates, which are substantially cheaper than the per-night rate for longer stays.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Staying Near Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital

faq.q: Which hotel is closest to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital in Bangkok?
faq.a: The 9 Residence Hotel is the closest stay we've reviewed — just 150 metres from the hospital entrance, a 5-minute walk through Itsara Chai Alley with no main road to cross. Next closest are The Pool Resort Bangkok at 0.3 km (3-min drive) and Sky Place Srinakarin at 0.5 km (4-min drive). Onix Hotel Bangkok is about 500 m from the hospital but uniquely offers a free hospital minibus to the hotel door.

faq.q: Which hotels near Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Three stays in this list have pools, ordered by distance from the hospital: The Pool Resort Bangkok (0.3 km) has an outdoor pool and jacuzzi from ฿650; Sky Place Srinakarin (0.5 km) has an indoor pool plus sauna from ฿600 — the cheapest pool option; The Xtreme Suites (1.5 km) has an outdoor pool, onsen and a full spa from ฿900.

faq.q: Does Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital offer a shuttle to nearby hotels?
faq.a: Based on multiple guest reviews, Onix Hotel Bangkok (500 m from the hospital) is the one stay where the hospital sends a free minibus to pick up guests. You simply inform the hotel front desk in advance, and they coordinate the timing. We have not confirmed this service independently — always verify with the hotel when you check in.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital?
faq.a: The most convenient route is the Airport Rail Link (ARL) from Suvarnabhumi to Hua Mak station — about 20 minutes. From Hua Mak, take a motorbike taxi or Grab (~10–15 min) to the hospital. If you're staying at Sky Place Srinakarin, ARL Hua Mak is only 720 m on foot from the hotel. Alternatively, a Grab direct from the airport to the hospital or your hotel takes about 30–40 minutes and typically costs ฿300–400 depending on traffic.

faq.q: Which stay is best for a long stay of several weeks near Samitivej Srinakarin?
faq.a: It depends on your priority. For a full kitchen and washing machine so you can cook and do laundry in-room, Floraville Serviced Apartments is the only option — but read the review carefully first and verify the room condition before booking. For a comfortable balance of proximity, room quality, and value over a longer stay, The 9 Residence Hotel (5-min walk to the hospital) or Onix Hotel Bangkok (4-star, free hospital shuttle) are more reliable choices.

faq.q: Is there a BTS or MRT close to Samitivej Srinakarin Hospital?
faq.a: There is no BTS directly serving the hospital area. The most practical public transit option is ARL Hua Mak station, which is 600 m to 3.5 km from the stays in this list depending on which you choose — Sky Place Srinakarin and Floraville are closest at around 600–720 m. The MRT Yellow Line runs along Srinagarindra Road; the nearest station is Sri Kritha, but you'll still need a short motorbike taxi or Grab to reach the hospital. For the most part, this area works best with private transport or a Grab app.
